'''Niksel Frangee''' was a detective of the [[Corellian Security Force]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|One of our most trusted guys! He even trained me. Wait, you're not a cop are you? You take out Frangee and that'll prove you're not a rat snitch yourself.|Borvo's guard, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BG" />}}
Agent Frangee was a detective of the [[Corellian Security Force]]. Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he joined an investigation against the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Borvo]]. Frangee traveled from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and infiltrated [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|Borvo the Hutt's criminal organization]].<ref name="SWG:BGATTC" /> He was introduced to Borvo by [[Montrus]], one of Borvo's business partner.<ref name="SWG:BA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Borvo's Assignments|Naboo}}</ref> Frangee stayed undercover for the next six years<ref name="SWG:BC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Bluffing CorSec|Corellia}}</ref> and became an important of the criminal organization. He even trained [[Borvo's guard|Borvo's personal bodyguard]].<ref name="SWG:BG" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the CorSec investigation against Borvo the Hutt came to an end.<ref name="SWG:BC" /> An important [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] operation was therefore organized to trap the gang during an illegal weapon sale near [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]]. The mission was a success and almost every Borvo's men were killed or arrested. Only [[Dagorel]], Borvo's hand man, escaped but the criminal was able to report Frangee's treason to Borvo.<ref name="SWG:BtHG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Borvo The Hutt's Guard|Naboo}}</ref> The detective was then murdered in the [[Paitnnu Wetlands]] by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] in Borvo's employment.<ref name="SWG:BG" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Oh...Oh, my! That badge! you're Agent Niksel. You look exactly like I thought you would. So, you've returned!|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Thale Dustrunner|Dustrunner]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BGATTC" />}}
During the six years in infiltration, all of Niksel Frangee's direct superiors had retired and been replaced. Thus, nobody in the CorSec knew how Frangee looked like at the moment of his death. The spacer who killed him later used Frangee's CorSec badge to pass himself off as Frangee on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:BGATTC" /> The spacer met one of the CorSec senior officers, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Thale Dustrunner]], in the [[Coronet Capitol]]. Dustrunner fell for the ruse and took the spacer for the long lost agent. He ordered him to protect [[Aldalad]], a witness who wanted to testify against Borvo, and [[Maerzen]], who had discovered evidence against Borvo the Hutt. The spacer killed both of them and returned to Naboo, leaving the CorSec without any evidence against the Hutt crime lord.<ref name="SWG:BC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateThug.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Niksel Frangee]]
Niksel Frangee appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Because Frangee spawned under the generic "borvo_frangee" template, his appearance was randomized under one of thirty-five possible depictions. However, the scenario clearly identified him as male.<ref name="SWG:BG" />

Frangee was present in the original release of the game, being part of [[W:c:swg:Borvo the Hutt questline (pre-NGE)|Borvo the Hutt's questline]].<ref name="SWG:BtHG" /> With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> Borvo the Hutt's questline was [[W:c:swg:Borvo the Hutt questline|revamped]]. While the gameplay of the questline was extensively upgraded, the storyline remained similar.<ref name="SWG:BG" />
